queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS standings_records FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(standings_records) AS avg_records FROM counts) SELECT constructorId, nationality, standings_records, standings_records - avg_records AS difference_from_average FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE standings_records > avg_records ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, constructorId LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS standings_records FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), compared AS (SELECT constructorId, nationality, standings_records, standings_records - AVG(standings_records * 1.0) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM counts) SELECT constructorId, nationality, standings_records, difference_from_average FROM compared WHERE difference_from_average > 0 ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, constructorId LIMIT 10;
